coordinate_frame.origin: Nominal ground point below axle midpoint; all config/layout and assembly_instances positions use this frame

scope: Maximum allocation requirements, not manufacturer drawings. No supplier hole patterns frozen. Stage B requires exact models, connector and flange dimensions, mass and procurement cost.

drive_motor_each.note: Axis X; includes encoder in 65 mm length; actual shaft / flange unselected

yaw_servo.note: Output axis +Z; flange excluded and must fit reserved mount space

interaction_mcu.note: Compact ESP32-S3 board required; antenna and USB reserve separate

motion_mcu.note: Compact ESP32-S3 board required; antenna and USB reserve separate

battery.note: Packing allocation only; capacity follows measured power, not locked

camera.note: Lens barrel and window separate; intrinsics unknown

display.note: Circular PCB allocation, active diameter 58; NOT actual selected screen

imu.note: Rigid frame; old candidate PCB fits this box, connector heights still TBD

usb_power.note: USB-C receptacle and plug envelope separate

motor_driver.note: Electrical suitability and FOC/PWM choice unresolved

power_module.note: Combined BMS/regulation allocation; protection/charger electrical topology pending

yaw.load_path: head -> pitch bilateral bearings -> yoke -> turntable hollow stem -> yaw bearing -> carrier posts -> load frame
yaw.drive_path: yaw servo -> horn -> slotted drive web -> hollow stem/turntable
yaw.cable_passage: Limited 140-degree arc slot in rotor drive web, fixed bundle center radius 6.4 mm; hollow stem bore diameter 15.4 mm; no slipring. Strength and cable flex NOT_TESTED

pitch.pivot: same geometric point as yaw axis at head sphere center
pitch.load_path: shell/cradle -> paired steel trunnion candidates -> bilateral bearing references -> yaw-fixed yoke
pitch.drive_path: pitch servo -> horn/coupler -> left trunnion -> rotating cradle
pitch.bearing_fit: Trial journal Ø4.98 into nominal Ø5 allocation; not supplier fit approval

legacy_sources.warning: Legacy A0 files are history, not V1 geometry. Candidate dimensions must be checked again. Existing 71 mm ESP32-S3 DevKit envelope exceeds 48 mm V1 allocation; select compact boards or revise geometry; do not shrink hardware.

procurement_status: BLOCKED: exact models, feedback/control performance and complete <=1000 CNY budget not verified

interfaces.fastener_note: Model trial mechanical holes belong only to candidate printed interfaces; coupons required before tolerances are frozen.

maintenance.precondition: DISARMED / DOCKED_MAINTENANCE, wheel drive disabled before insertion, plugged-in free driving prohibited
maintenance.power_switch: A candidate physical power-cut control allocation; electrical emergency-stop behavior and accessibility require hardware confirmation
maintenance.battery_path: Remove lower shell, disconnect battery, remove hangers; tray + battery downward 90 mm; slot Y adjustment +/-4 mm

generated_instances: ../mechanical/reports/assembly_instances.json (derived output; DO NOT EDIT as input)
stage_b_required_data: Exact manufacturer/model and dated mechanical drawing
Measured max envelopes including flanges/connectors/wire exits
Shaft diameter, usable length, flat/key/spline and axial retention
Hole positions, thread depth, screw/insert exact SKU and fits
Mass and center of mass including harness
Complete itemized CNY bill incl shipping and one print run
Display/camera optics, FOV, window material and calibration

body_frame.axes: Same XYZ orientation at neutral pose
